1233d799431e28d0.description: About DHL Global Forwarding DHL Global Forwarding, Freight (DGFF) is the air, ocean, and road freight specialist within DHL Group, operating in over 220 countries worldwide. The company provides standardized transport and specialized end-to-end solutions to customers across various industries globally. DHL has been a pioneer in cross-border express shipping since 1969. The Role: Head of CDZ DHL Global Forwarding is seeking a Head of CDZ to join its team in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and involves leading customs and trade compliance strategies and operations for the region. Key Responsibilities Formulate customs and trade compliance strategies aligned with regional business objectives and corporate guidelines. Direct the planning and implementation of customs and regulatory affairs plans, measures, and budgets. Organize and control customs and regulatory affairs activities to secure necessary permits, licenses, and approvals for business operations. Drive the fulfillment of customs requirements for import, export, and trans-shipment in a time-sensitive environment. Set and ensure high standards of operational quality in customs clearance processes and data quality. Monitor customs operations and documentation teams to optimize productivity and control costs. Deploy effective people management, cost control, innovation, and communication to achieve high customer satisfaction. Liaise with customs authorities and other governmental bodies on operational matters. Network and build relationships with customs authorities and counterparts to ensure smooth operations. Anticipate and mitigate business risks by proactively monitoring changes in statutory regulations. Set customs processes and procedures, monitoring implementation to adhere to compliance standards and legal requirements. Drive innovation and embed world-class practices and quality standards for customs at the regional level. Advise customers on legal and customs topics, including trade compliance for shipments to sanctioned countries. Engage in extensive contact and negotiation with other departments and third parties with potentially conflicting objectives. Influence and challenge key stakeholders effectively, developing strong cross-functional relationships with senior DHL business leaders. Represent the Group as an internally and externally recognized thought leader. Champion cooperation and partnership to provide integrated solutions. Lead multiple teams of executives, directors/senior managers, and managers. Develop short to long-term plans (1-5 years) for optimizing the organization, function, or job-family and the required talent. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to formulate and implement strategic plans. Strong leadership and people management skills. Proficiency in customs regulations and trade compliance. Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities. Working at DHL DHL Global Forwarding is part of Deutsche Post DHL, a leading logistics provider. The company is a certified TOP EMPLOYER, recognized for its efforts in attracting and retaining talent through a positive work environment and support for professional development. DHL Global Forwarding is an equal opportunity employer, evaluating qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. Career Development This role offers opportunities within a global company where contributions can impact shared goals. Potential for further career development is available within the organization.

1254394b8e6d981c.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Director Design (Velodrome) to lead the end-to-end design management of a major Velodrome asset. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role focuses on ensuring the venue delivers an exceptional athlete, spectator, and operational experience while meeting international sporting, technical, and design standards. Key Responsibilities Lead the design strategy, development, and coordination of the Velodrome from concept through detailed design, construction, and handover. Manage and direct Lead Design Consultants, specialist sports designers, architects, and engineering consultants, holding them accountable for design quality, program, and deliverables. Ensure the design responds to the highly specialist requirements of a competition-standard indoor cycling venue, including track integration, field of play, spectator experience, athlete facilities, back-of-house, and venue operations. Coordinate architecture, structural, MEP, acoustics, lighting, technology, security, accessibility, and sustainability requirements into an integrated venue design. Work closely with Development, Project Delivery, Commercial, and Operations teams to ensure design decisions support budget, program, constructability, and long-term operational requirements. Lead design reviews, value engineering, and technical decision-making while protecting the overall design intent and venue quality. Manage stakeholder engagement with sporting bodies, operators, and other key internal and external stakeholders. Required Qualifications and Experience Significant experience leading the design of major sports venues, arenas, stadia, or similarly complex public assembly buildings. Velodrome, indoor arena, or specialist sporting venue experience is highly advantageous. Strong client-side design leadership and experience managing major multidisciplinary design consultancies. Excellent stakeholder management, technical leadership, and design coordination capability. Work Environment This role operates within a dynamic project environment, requiring close collaboration with various internal teams and external consultants to deliver a world-class Velodrome facility. The position is full-time and based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates interested in this Director Design (Velodrome) position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

1210c52dd4552d19.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على أعمال المباني المختلفة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المتنوعة، وتجهيز قائمة بالأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز المهام. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. الإشراف على أعمال المباني من حيث الدهان وصيانة الصرف الصحي والمياه وأعمال النجارة وترميم الأثاث الموجود. العمل على وضع خطة للمتابعة الدورية لأعمال صيانة المباني لضمان استمرارية جودة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لخطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للمباني. القدرة على تحديد العيوب الفنية واقتراح حلول عملية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد قوائم المواد والأدوات والعمال. القدرة على قراءة وتوضيح المخططات الفنية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية ومتابعة ممتازة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والإشراف على فرق العمل. مهارات تواصل فعالة لرفع التقارير والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. الدقة في قياس وحساب الكميات وتدقيقها. نوع الوظيفة وموقعها هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للدور إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقديم لهذه الفرصة ضمن فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات.

121638663165678f.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Cook to join the team in Makkah. This full-time position involves preparing and cooking food according to established recipes and quality standards, ensuring a high level of food preparation and presentation. The role requires 0-1 years of experience in a similar capacity. Key Responsibilities Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food items. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables, and accurately weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food in adherence to recipes, quality standards, presentation guidelines, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items as required. Operate kitchen equipment such as ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to confirm sufficient cooking and monitor food quality throughout the preparation process. Set up and break down the work station efficiently. Serve food in proper portions using appropriate receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen areas, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of appliance and food temperatures. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures, reporting maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Communicate with colleagues using clear and professional language, develop positive working relationships, and support the team in achieving common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. About the Team The Le Méridien brand, part of Marriott International, draws inspiration from the era of glamorous travel, celebrating each culture through a distinctly European spirit. The team aims to provide authentic, chic, and memorable service and experiences that inspire guests to appreciate their destination. This role offers an opportunity to join a global team within Marriott International, where individuals can contribute their best work and develop professionally.

120e5b790c5983b6.description: About the Role GT Medical is seeking a Sales Representative to join our team in Saudi Arabia, specifically covering Jeddah and Riyadh. This full-time role involves promoting high-quality healthcare products to pharmacies and achieving sales targets within an assigned territory. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Achieve annual sales targets in line with the sales forecast. Conduct 20 pharmacy visits daily within the assigned territory to promote products and drive sales. Execute sales and marketing plans to maximize product reach and market share. Educate pharmacy staff on product features, benefits, and proper usage. Improve product visibility, availability, and shelf positioning at pharmacy locations. Build and maintain long-term relationships with pharmacy customers. Submit accurate sales reports and territory plans on time. Monitor product shelf life and support inventory management to minimize expiry. Gather and report market intelligence, competitor activity, and customer feedback. Stay current on product knowledge, new launches, and industry trends. Candidate Profile We are looking for a motivated sales professional with 2-5 years of experience. The successful candidate will be customer-focused and possess strong problem-solving and organizational skills. This role requires an individual who can work independently while contributing effectively to a high-performing team. Required Skills and Attributes Self-motivated and customer-focused. Strong problem-solving and organizational skills. Ability to work independently within a high-performing team. Driven to achieve targets and deliver excellent customer service. Work Environment At GT Medical, we foster a collaborative environment. This full-time position offers opportunities for professional growth within the healthcare sector. About GT Medical GT Medical is dedicated to bringing high-quality healthcare products to pharmacies. We invest in our people and aim to shape the future of healthcare.

121f5b8fa87ec5c6.description: About Flow Flow is a company focused on redefining living, working, and connection experiences. It operates as a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem encompassing condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. The company aims to create flexible, connected living experiences that foster community and value for residents. Flow's mission prioritizes resident experiences, fostering connection among residents, with themselves, and with the natural world, to build human-centered communities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Building General Manager Role As the Building General Manager, you will oversee all operational aspects of a Flow community, ensuring a high-quality experience for residents. This full-time role involves leading a team to achieve resident satisfaction and retention, and collaborating cross-functionally to optimize property performance. The position requires a hands-on leader who can thrive in a dynamic environment and is committed to creating a welcoming and high-quality living experience. Key Responsibilities Foster an engaged community and ensure high levels of resident satisfaction. Respond promptly and professionally to resident inquiries, complaints, and requests. Implement strategies to enhance resident retention and long-term occupancy. Organize community initiatives to strengthen engagement and foster a sense of belonging. Recruit, train, and lead a high-performing team focused on exceptional service. Set clear goals, performance metrics, and accountability measures for the team. Cultivate a culture of ownership, urgency, and high standards within the team. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs. Develop and implement strategies to drive occupancy, revenue growth, and brand positioning. Collaborate with marketing and leasing teams to refine campaigns and drive demand. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in property management or a related field. Demonstrated leadership skills with experience in team management and development. Strong understanding of operational and financial management principles within real estate. Ability to develop and implement strategies for resident satisfaction and retention. Proficiency in market analysis and strategic planning to drive property performance. About Flow in the MENA Region Flow was established in 2021 with a $350 million investment from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The company expanded into the MENA region in 2024 through the acquisition of nearly one thousand residential units in Saudi Arabia, establishing itself as a significant owner and operator of residential real estate in the Kingdom. Joining Flow at this stage offers an opportunity to contribute to the launch of flagship communities and the development of resident experiences in the region. Application Process Flow may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support various stages of the hiring process, including application review, resume analysis, and assessment of responses. These tools are intended to assist the recruitment team and do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. For more information regarding data processing, please contact us.

1221ce1ed46e2139.description: About the Role Roche is seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join their team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on transforming healthcare outcomes by collaborating with various stakeholders within Saudi Arabia's dynamic healthcare environment. The PJP will work to improve patient care in partnership with regulators, providers, and communities. Role Purpose The Patient Journey Partner acts as a bridge between external partners and Roche. This involves understanding external needs to identify opportunities for faster patient outcome transformation, while also bringing Roche's expertise, science, and knowledge to the healthcare ecosystem. Key Responsibilities Serve as a trusted partner and the primary point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. Communicate patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritize resources, and drive solutions to deliver outcomes efficiently. Collaborate with patient journey stakeholders to address challenges and identify opportunities for patient and community value. Manage Roche’s products throughout their lifecycle, supporting appropriate use and sharing their merits with healthcare professionals in a balanced manner. Oversee the entire patient journey, applying a systems-thinking approach to identify shared goals among stakeholders and co-create solutions. Utilize local and network expertise and resources as needed, including collaboration with other PJPs. Ensure positive experiences for stakeholders interacting with Roche employees, products, and services. Qualifications and Requirements Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, including partnership with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and organizations. Experience leading cross-functional teams. Strong business acumen, with desired expertise in commercialization, medical affairs, and customer experience excellence. Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments within defined disease area(s) to facilitate specialist-level engagement. Broad understanding of Roche’s current portfolio and future pipeline to develop future-oriented solutions. Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics, including clinical research. Work Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, covering the cities of Jeddah and Makkah. Application Information Candidates committed to improving patient lives and driving impactful change are encouraged to apply for this role at Roche.

12823a62f8382abf.description: About the Role Apparel Group is seeking a Service Crew to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for driving sales, delivering exceptional customer service, and supporting various operational duties within the store. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Generate sales and provide high-quality customer service. Support operational duties including housekeeping and visual merchandising standards as assigned. Ensure a positive first impression for guests through proper appearance and maintaining a clean, inviting environment. Follow "Always Fresh" procedures to ensure product quality and accuracy. Deliver consistent guest service with a friendly attitude, attentive behavior, and strong product knowledge. Enhance guest experience by applying *** Principles: Smile, Eye Contact, Thank You. Ensure accuracy of every order and provide prompt, warm greetings to guests within 5 seconds. Maintain speed of service targets by working efficiently to fulfill orders. Execute service recovery promptly for any guest concerns or complaints. Store Operations and Procedures Adhere to all operational standards and guidelines for product preparation. Prepare products accurately following the order monitor. Communicate product needs to ensure availability for guests. Regularly record product temperatures in the Time & Temperature Log. Participate in and attend all store meetings and related functions. Follow all restaurant policies, procedures, and standards. Maintain a clean, organized, and stocked front counter, ready for rush periods. Adhere to proper hand washing techniques and all sanitation guidelines. Count cash till at the beginning of shifts to ensure correct amounts and adequate change. Maintain clean and orderly checkout areas. Utilize personal protective equipment or clothing as required. Report all injuries/illnesses, accidents, unsafe conditions, and security incidents to the Restaurant Manager or Owner. Operate equipment and work in a manner that ensures the safety of all individuals. Qualifications 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Ability to deliver excellent customer service. Strong communication skills and a friendly demeanor. Capability to perform operational duties and maintain store standards. Adherence to health and safety regulations.

12841b8c4c89276c.description: About the Role Yanbu Aramco Sinopec Refining Company (YASREF) Ltd. is seeking a Senior IT System Analyst to join their team in Al Madinah, specifically in Yanbu or Medina. This full-time role involves providing professional support across various IT programming, application, and operation tasks, including designing, documenting, and coding program logic. The Senior IT System Analyst will also provide technical training and guidance to end-users and departmental staff, ensuring the smooth operation and enhancement of existing applications. Key Responsibilities Develop and enhance existing applications, identify areas for modification, and contribute to new application development to meet customer requirements. Research, design, develop, and test operating system-level software, compilers, network distribution software, and computing applications. Document current state architecture, design ideal state architecture, and develop deployment plans for new solutions aligned with business needs. Create, update, and maintain application software development roadmaps, ensuring prioritization aligns with business requirements. Perform complex programming tasks, including designing, documenting, and coding program logic, and provide application support and enhancements. Define system requirements, priorities, and viable alternatives, and coordinate staff efforts for software system installation, testing, and maintenance. Lead projects, direct IT systems analysts, and provide technical training, guidance, and resource support to end-users and departmental staff. Develop user documentation and departmental policies and procedures impacting application systems, and monitor system releases for organizational applicability. Maintain Standard Operating Procedures for all technology systems and processes, provide necessary logs and reports for internal investigations, and manage escalations. Design and perform application software tests, diagnose and correct performance issues, and monitor systems and user behavior for suspicious activity. Conduct horizon scanning, explore external developments, and evaluate their potential impact or usefulness to the organization. Ensure operational compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and regulatory codes, and manage workstreams or small projects within transformational change programs. Ensure compliance with all cybersecurity guidelines and procedures related to change control, security, auditing, release, configuration, problem, and incident management. Monitor daily operational activities, evaluate overall performance, provide regular updates to Senior Management, and offer end-user training as needed. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in IT system analysis, programming, and application support. Demonstrated ability to design, document, and code program logic effectively. Experience in providing technical training and guidance to end-users and departmental staff. Proficiency in supporting and enhancing existing applications. Strong analytical skills for identifying areas of modification and improvement in applications. Communication and Collaboration The role requires regular internal reporting and communication with hierarchy, implementing pertinent policies, and exchanging information regarding KPIs and performance parameters. The Senior IT System Analyst will engage in technical discussions with stakeholders both inside and outside the organization to ensure the provision of optimal technical solutions in YASREF's interest. This includes providing guidance and solutions for project implementation problems. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Madinah, specifically in Yanbu or Medina. The role involves supporting the planning, execution, and implementation of various IT programs in compliance with organizational strategies and operational priorities.

12a69ef0bab120fb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية عن محاضر بدوام كامل للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة حفر الباطن. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تعليم عالي الجودة للطلاب، مع التركيز على التخصصات الأكاديمية وإجراء البحوث ذات الصلة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدريس الأكاديمي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس المسارات التخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. تقييم أداء الطلبة بشكل دوري وفعال. إجراء البحوث والدراسات المتخصصة في مجال الاختصاص. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بأداء الطلبة وتحصيلهم وتقدمهم. إعداد خطط الدروس النظرية بما يتماشى مع المناهج المعتمدة. تصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التعليمية الفاعلة لدعم العملية التعليمية. اختيار أساليب وطرق تدريس المادة النظرية للمسار. تقديم المحاضرات في مجال التخصص بوضوح وفعالية. المشاركة في تنفيذ خطة الدراسات والأبحاث الخاصة بالأكاديمية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدريس الأكاديمي أو البحث العلمي. القدرة على تدريس مسارات تخصصية لطلبة التعليم العالي. مهارات ممتازة في التقييم الأكاديمي وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على إجراء البحوث والدراسات العلمية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على تصميم وتطبيق استراتيجيات تدريس مبتكرة. إتقان استخدام التقنيات التعليمية الحديثة. الالتزام بالمعايير الأكاديمية والجودة التعليمية. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاضر ضمن بيئة أكاديمية ديناميكية في أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية، حيث يساهم في تطوير قدرات الطلاب وتقدمهم العلمي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في أكاديمية الجزيرة العالمية.

12db29e67f56dd4e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة الصفر لتنظيم المعارض والمؤتمرات عن حاجتها لمدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، وتوجيه عمليات تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة، مع ضمان توفيرها في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة. الإشراف على تحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع مشاريع أو برامج أخرى لضمان الاستغلال الأمثل للموارد المتاحة، وتحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة المشروع المعتمدة ومواصفات الجودة، وإدارة عمليات التغيير وفقاً للخطط الموضوعة. تنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه، وتقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق الوثائق والنماذج والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء وعوامل النجاح بشكل دوري، ورفعها إلى الأطراف المعنية والإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير خطط تنفيذ المشاريع ومراقبة سير العمل. متطلبات العمل القدرة على وضع وتتبع موازنات المشاريع وإجراءاتها التعاقدية. مهارات تحديد تكاليف المشاريع ومصادر تمويلها. القدرة على متابعة عمليات التنفيذ لضمان إنجاز المشاريع وتحقيق أهدافها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

12463f9e31a45301.company_name: روضة المستقبل الذهبي الاهلية هدى علي عارف الزهراني
12463f9e31a45301.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن حاضنة أطفال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير رعاية شاملة للأطفال، مع التركيز على تنظيم جداولهم اليومية، وضمان بيئة نظيفة وآمنة، وتقديم الدعم التربوي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال رعاية الأطفال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم الجداول اليومية للأطفال لضمان أدائهم للنشاطات الثقافية والترفيهية اللازمة وحصولهم على قسط كافٍ من الراحة. ضمان نظافة وترتيب سكن الأطفال بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. العناية بالأطفال على كافة الصعد الدينية والصحية والاجتماعية والأخلاقية، وتقديم الرعاية التربوية الشاملة لهم. الالتزام التام بكافة الإجراءات والسياسات المتعلقة بحضانة الأطفال والمحافظة على قواعد وسياسات السلامة العامة. إعداد التقارير الفنية عن سير العمل ورفعها إلى الرئيس المباشر، وتوضيح الصعوبات التي تواجه سير الأعمال والعمليات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال رعاية الأطفال أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنظيم وإدارة جداول الأنشطة اليومية للأطفال. فهم جيد لأسس النظافة والسلامة في بيئة رعاية الأطفال. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتعامل مع الأطفال. القدرة على تقديم الرعاية التربوية الشاملة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والسياسات المنظمة. مهارات إعداد التقارير الأساسية. بيئة العمل ستعمل حاضنة الأطفال ضمن فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل في مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة تضمن سلامة الأطفال وراحتهم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال مراحل التوظيف.

12a8e49e314c5b19.description: JASARA PMC is a joint venture between PIF, Jacobs, and Aramco, operating in the management consulting sector. The company brings together deep project and professional services expertise to support complex, high-impact work, with a strong focus on operational rigor, financial discipline, and effective collaboration across stakeholders. As an Accounts Payable Senior Officer, you will play an important role in supporting the accuracy and integrity of the payables function. This role is suited to someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and confident working across teams to help ensure smooth financial operations, strong controls, and timely resolution of payment-related matters. Responsibilities Process and verify supplier invoices against purchase orders and supporting documentation. Reconcile vendor accounts and promptly resolve invoice or payment discrepancies. Prepare payment runs and ensure approvals follow established financial controls. Maintain accurate accounts payable records and support month-end closing activities. Coordinate with vendors and internal teams regarding outstanding payment inquiries. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a closely related field. Five years of accounts payable or general accounting experience, ideally within construction or consulting finance environments. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and SAP or Oracle. Experience supporting month-end close processes and working with approval workflows. Experience maintaining audit-ready documentation. Ability to work effectively with vendors, procurement teams, finance leadership, and internal approvers. Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia.

12f73c18541c5232.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال الصيانة الدورية وتشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بحسب البرامج المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على فهم وتطبيق المخططات الفنية وتشخيص الأعطال بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات قوية في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. القدرة على تقدير تكاليف المواد والمستلزمات اللازمة للصيانة. مهارات متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل واضحة ومفصلة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الصيانة الميكانيكية في بيئة صناعية ديناميكية ضمن شركة اقوات للصناعات الغذائية في مدينة جدة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام ببرامج الصيانة المجدولة وغير المجدولة لضمان استمرارية العمليات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص والمساهمة في عمليات الصيانة الحيوية لشركة رائدة في مجال الصناعات الغذائية.

12fc48d8ca5ef9f2.description: نبحث عن مشرف إنتاج ذو خبرة للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف الإنتاج بكفاءة. ستشمل مسؤولياتك الإشراف على العمليات الإنتاجية اليومية، وضمان الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة، وتحفيز فريق العمل لتحقيق أفضل النتائج. ندعوك للانضمام إلى بيئة عمل محفزة وفرص للنمو المهني. * الإشراف على سير العمليات الإنتاجية وضمان تحقيق الخطط الموضوعة. * مراقبة جودة المنتجات والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المطلوبة. * توجيه وتدريب فريق العمل لرفع مستوى الأداء وزيادة الإنتاجية. * تحليل البيانات الإنتاجية وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة. * المساهمة في تطوير وتحسين العمليات الإنتاجية. يفضل وجود مؤهل دبلوم او بكالوريوس في تخصص المواد الكيميائية، الهندسة الكيميائية، علوم مختبرات،

12fd8b8b9a3e995e.company_name: King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital
12fd8b8b9a3e995e.description: About the Role Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Consultant Plastic Surgeon to provide high-standard clinical care and expertise in the assessment, investigation, diagnosis, and treatment of patients within plastic surgery and related conditions. This is a permanent position requiring 3-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Manage assigned clinics according to the approved rota and admit patients within assigned privileges. Conduct initial assessment, investigation, diagnosis, treatment, re-assessment, and follow-up of patients. Prescribe and administer medication, therapy, and other appropriate care. Explain procedures and discuss diagnostic results or prescribed treatments with patients and/or authorized attendants. Monitor patient conditions, progress, and re-evaluate treatment plans accordingly. Refer patients to other consultants/specialists and provide consulting services when requested. Perform daily rounds on admitted and referred patients. Ensure completeness and authentication of all medical records, updating patient progress as per hospital policies. Review and validate entries and notes of junior medical staff for patients under care. Perform diagnostic and/or therapeutic procedures for which privileges are granted. Approve discharge summaries, follow-up plans, and medical reports. Assume duties as Head of the Department when required. Ensure implementation of approved policies, procedures, regulations, and clinical pathways. Direct, supervise, and coordinate activities of specialists, residents, nurses, and other medical staff. Advise and contribute to policy and procedure development for continuous quality improvement. Serve on Departmental/Hospital Committees as required. Ensure adherence to Islamic Values and Medical Ethics. Be available for On-Call duties as per hospital policy and attend emergency codes. Provide patient medical reports and information as required by management. Identify and report Medico-Legal Cases to management in a timely manner. Participate in clinical/academic activities and patient/family education on healthy lifestyles. Contribute to community health awareness and education. Maintain regularity and punctuality in assigned duties and follow all hospital policies. Obtain informed consent for all diagnostic procedures, operations, tests, or treatments. Participate in and lead person-centered care initiatives. Provide orientation, bedside training, and supervision to trainees. Participate in self- and others’ education, training, and departmental educational activities. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect, and dignity. Perform other applicable tasks and duties within the scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities. Qualifications and Requirements Graduate of a Medical School recognized by the Medical Council of the country of origin. Completion of appropriate internship and residency programs. Post-graduate qualifications in the specialty of plastic surgery. Experience Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in plastic surgery. Work Type This is a permanent employment opportunity. Application Process Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

122e7cc9c81abc60.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المجال جي 4 اس عن فني تبريد وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان كفاءة عمل أنظمة التكييف والتبريد من خلال تنفيذ مهام التركيب والصيانة والإصلاح. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، براتب إجمالي قدره 5,400 ريال سعودي شامل البدلات، ومتاحة في مدن جدة، مكة المكرمة، ينبع، القصيم، الرياض، والدمام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب أنظمة التكييف والتبريد المختلفة وفقًا للمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الصيانة الدورية والوقائية للأجهزة والأنظمة لضمان استمرارية عملها. تشخيص الأعطال الفنية في أنظمة التبريد والتكييف وإصلاحها بفعالية. التأكد من كفاءة عمل الأجهزة والأنظمة بعد التركيب أو الصيانة. التعامل مع أي مشكلات فنية طارئة ومعالجتها في الوقت المناسب. المؤهلات والمتطلبات الحصول على دبلوم أو شهادة فنية في تخصص التبريد والتكييف أو تخصص ذي صلة. الخبرة المطلوبة: 0-1 سنة. حديثو التخرج مرحب بهم للتقدم لهذا الدور. تعتبر الخبرة من سنة إلى سنتين في مجال التبريد والتكييف ميزة إضافية. نطاق العمل هذا الدور متاح في عدة مدن بالمملكة العربية السعودية، بما في ذلك جدة، مكة المكرمة، ينبع، القصيم، الرياض، والدمام. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل لضمان تغطية جميع المهام والمسؤوليات المتعلقة بأنظمة التبريد والتكييف. الراتب الراتب الإجمالي لهذا المنصب هو 5,400 ريال سعودي، ويشمل هذا المبلغ جميع البدلات.

1245f1f9e5ba44c2.job_title: Associate Director Asset Finance Business Partner
1245f1f9e5ba44c2.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Asset Finance Business Partner (CORS364) to act as a strategic finance partner for assigned assets and business units. This full-time role involves providing financial insights, performance analysis, and investment support to drive business performance and value creation within the organization's Finance Business Partners structure. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this position is to serve as a dedicated financial expert, collaborating closely with asset and business leaders. The role focuses on delivering comprehensive financial support, including budgeting, forecasting, and strategic financial planning, to ensure sound decision-making and optimal asset performance. Key Responsibilities Partner with asset and business leaders to inform strategic and financial decisions. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities for assigned units. Monitor asset performance, identify potential risks and opportunities, and recommend improvements. Review business cases, investment proposals, and capital expenditure requests. Deliver financial analysis, reporting, and performance insights to management. Ensure compliance with financial policies, controls, and governance requirements. Support cross-functional initiatives and continuous improvement projects across the organization. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience in finance, with a focus on business partnering, financial planning, and analysis. Demonstrated ability to provide strategic financial insights and support to senior leadership. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply.

124d23a6fba35cb9.description: About Eram Talent Eram Talent is actively seeking qualified and experienced professionals for various opportunities within the Upstream & Drilling sector in Saudi Arabia. We are looking for talented individuals across multiple disciplines to contribute to significant projects in the region. The Field Compliance Specialist Role This full-time position is for a Field Compliance Specialist within the Upstream & Drilling sector. The role involves ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations in a challenging project environment. The Field Compliance Specialist will be an integral part of operations, contributing to the overall integrity and safety of projects. Key Disciplines of Interest Eram Talent is seeking professionals across a broad range of disciplines for the Upstream & Drilling sector. While this specific advertisement is for a Field Compliance Specialist, candidates with expertise in the following areas are also encouraged to apply: Engineering Drilling Exploration Supply Chain Project Management Construction Inspection Telecommunications Instrumentation & Control IT Support Candidate Requirements Ideal candidates for the Field Compliance Specialist role, and other positions within the Upstream & Drilling sector, should meet the following criteria: Possess relevant educational qualifications and professional experience in their respective discipline. Demonstrate strong technical knowledge and relevant industry experience. Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas, Upstream, or Drilling industry (preferred). Exhibit the ability to work effectively in a challenging project environment. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to share their updated CVs. Please ensure to mention the relevant job title, such as Field Compliance Specialist, in your application to facilitate proper consideration.

126924271d7c906b.job_title: Airport Services Duty Officer Al Ula SA
126924271d7c906b.description: About the Role Qatar Airways is seeking an Airport Services Duty Officer to join its Ground Services team in Al Ula, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The successful candidate will supervise and control flight-handling activities to ensure high service standards and optimal customer satisfaction. Role Overview As the Airport Services Duty Officer, you will have overall control of the shift, acting as a direct representative of the Airport Services Manager. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure the punctuality and safety of all Qatar Airways operations, contributing to the on-time departure of flights. Key Responsibilities Supervise flight-handling activities, including flight editing, check-in, transfers, and boarding. Ensure that passenger and aircraft handling practices comply with safety and security standards. Meet all Qatar Airways aircraft handling standards on a shift basis. Manage and control manpower during the shift to optimize utilization and maintain staff morale and discipline. Ensure proper allocation of manpower and resources within airport operations. Conduct checks to ensure adequate service standards are maintained. Resolve customer problems and complaints while on duty, collaborating with departments such as Customer Relations for complaint handling. Facilitate ramp handling activities in liaison with the Ground Handling Agent (GHA), Caterers, Fueling, Maintenance, Cargo, and Crew to expedite departures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Al Ula, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

1283d021f12b97e1.description: About the Role NetApp is seeking a Senior Manager Solutions Engineering to lead a team of Solutions Engineers and front-line leaders. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on driving business growth by leveraging NetApp’s technical portfolio to achieve customer outcomes. The role involves maximizing revenue through team coaching and influencing customer buying decisions throughout the sales cycle, requiring regular travel for engagement with team members, customers, and partners. Responsibilities Lead a team of Solutions Engineers to drive regional growth with Client Executive teams, focusing on new account acquisition and expansion through upselling and cross-selling. Leverage the solution portfolio and messaging to demonstrate value across data infrastructure, cloud, cyber resiliency, AI, and Block benefits. Act as a technical sales orchestrator, engaging experts as needed to support successful outcomes. Maintain accurate forecasts and manage sales progression using designated sales tools. Consistently exceed sales quotas. Coach teams on conducting effective demos and Proofs of Concept (POCs) to build customer confidence and highlight solution value. Guide teams in documenting customer needs and developing proposals that illustrate solution benefits. Foster a high-performance culture through clear expectations, feedback, and rewards, aligned with Thrive Performance & Rewards. Identify and mentor high-potential team members, providing development opportunities. Manage underperformance fairly and recruit top talent to enhance productivity. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire high-performing technical sales teams. Experience in driving revenue growth and influencing customer buying decisions. Strong understanding of data infrastructure, cloud, cyber resiliency, AI, and Block benefits. About NetApp NetApp is a partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As an enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, NetApp enables customers to run workloads from traditional systems to enterprise AI with performance, resilience, and security. Application Process To ensure a fair hiring process, applications are reviewed only when submitted through the company website. Direct communication with employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel will not influence the application status. For certain roles, some stages of the hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence tools to assist in evaluating applications and candidate selection, supporting human decision-making.

1286eef9e648c341.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking a Quality and Safety Officer to ensure the effective implementation and continuous monitoring of Safety Management Systems (SMS) and Quality Management Systems (QMS) at Gateway Facilities. This full-time role is based at Riyadh Airport, with required monthly visits to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses in Khamis Mushayt, Hail, and Medina. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide Quality and Safety coverage from the assigned base location at Riyadh Airport. Extend Quality and Safety support to Dammam Airport and designated MODON industrial warehouses through planned monthly visits. Ensure consistent implementation, monitoring, and follow-up of Safety and Quality requirements across assigned locations. Ensure compliance with GACA regulations, company policies, and applicable aviation safety and quality standards. Support the effective implementation and continuous improvement of the SMS and QMS. Promote a positive safety and quality culture across Gateway Facilities. Planning and Internal Control Participate in safety and quality planning activities, including objectives, programs, and performance indicators. Assist in the development and maintenance of safety and quality manuals, procedures, and work instructions. Support risk assessment and hazard identification activities. Conduct internal inspections and compliance monitoring in line with approved inspection plans. Monitor corrective and preventive actions to ensure timely and effective closure. Verify compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements. Administration and Reporting Manage safety reports, non-conformities, and quality findings. Coordinate investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes. Maintain safety and quality records and documentation. Prepare and submit safety and quality reports, statistics, and performance summaries to management and relevant authorities as required. Track safety and quality trends and provide recommendations for improvement. Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) and Business Continuity Support the implementation of EHS policies and procedures. Monitor workplace health, safety, and environmental compliance. Promote awareness of EHS requirements and best practices. Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of business continuity and emergency response plans. Participate in drills, exercises, and post-exercise evaluations. Ensure safety and quality considerations are integrated into continuity planning. Performance Indicators The successful candidate will be expected to abide by the goal-setting forms (Individual KPIs) of the current financial year.

1289afe7b1ecf398.description: About the Role Wipro is seeking an experienced GCP Solution Architect / Apigee Architect to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves leading the architecture and implementation of an enterprise Integration Developer Portal. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for defining and guiding the technical vision for integration solutions, specifically focusing on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Apigee. This role requires a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and best practices to ensure the successful delivery of the Integration Developer Portal. Key Responsibilities Lead the architectural design of an enterprise Integration Developer Portal. Oversee the implementation of solutions leveraging GCP and Apigee technologies. Define technical standards and best practices for integration architecture. Collaborate with development teams to ensure architectural alignment and successful project delivery. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of professional experience in solution architecture. Demonstrated expertise as a GCP Solution Architect. Proven experience as an Apigee Architect. Strong background in designing and implementing enterprise integration solutions. 12e7f4591d592f59.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التقنية الموحدة للمقاولات عن حارس أمن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى حماية الممتلكات والحفاظ على النظام داخل أماكن العمل، من خلال المراقبة الدورية والتحكم في الدخول والخروج. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى حارس الأمن مسؤولية ضمان سلامة وأمن المنشأة وموظفيها وزوارها. يشمل ذلك القيام بدوريات منتظمة، ومراقبة نقاط الدخول، والاستجابة للحوادث الطارئة للحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة عمليات الدخول إلى المنشأة ومغادرتها، وإصدار التصاريح اللازمة لذلك. التحقق من هوية الموردين والزوار وتسجيل بياناتهم، وإصدار تصاريح الدخول لهم. القيام بدوريات منتظمة في أماكن العمل، وتفقد البوابات والأبواب والنوافذ لضمان إغلاقها وتأمينها. المرور بين الزوار والموظفين للحفاظ على النظام وحماية الممتلكات، ونشر اللوائح المعمول بها في المنشأة. الاستجابة الفورية للإنذارات والتحقيق في الحوادث المبلغ عنها. الاتصال بإدارات مكافحة الحرائق أو الإسعاف أو الشرطة عند الضرورة، وإبلاغ الإدارة العليا بالحوادث. الالتزام التام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الأمن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على المراقبة الفعالة واتخاذ القرارات السريعة في المواقف الطارئة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والقدرة على تطبيق السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية. بيئة العمل يعمل حارس الأمن بدوام كامل في مواقع شركة التقنية الموحدة للمقاولات بالجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. تتطلب الوظيفة اليقظة والجاهزية للتعامل مع مختلف الظروف الأمنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

121f268b922f5a04.description: الوصف الوظيفي: ميسّر عمليات الفود ترك (تحضير الطلبات والمحاسبة) المسمى الوظيفي: طاهٍ ومحاسب فود ترك (Food Truck All-Rounder) الموقع: الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية نوع العمل: جزئي إدارة التشغيل اليومي داخل الفود ترك بدءاً من استقبال الزبائن وأخذ الطلبات ومعالجتها عبر نظام النقاط (POS)، وصولاً إلى تحضير الوجبات وفق أعلى معايير الجودة والنظافة، وضمان تقديم خدمة سريعة ومتميزة للعملاء. ### المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية 1. الخدمة والمحاسبة (الكاشير): * استقبال العملاء بأسلوب ودود واحترافي. * تسجيل الطلبات بدقة على نظام الكاشير (POS) أو أدوات الدفع الإلكتروني (مدى / فيزا / كاش). * استلام المبالغ النقدية وتأكيد العمليات الشبكية وتوفير الباقي للعملاء بدقة. * إغلاق الصندوق (الكاشير) نهاية اليوم ومطابقة المبيعات النقدية والشبكية مع التقارير. 2. تحضير وإعداد الطلبات ( المطبخ): * تجهيز وتحضير المكونات الأساسية * طبخ و اعداد الوجبات بناءً على معايير الوصفات المعتمدة والسرعة المطلوبة. * تغليف الطلبات بشكل نظيف وآمن للتقديم أو التوصيل. * التأكد من خرج الطلب بشكل صحيح ومطابق لرغبة العميل (بدون أخطاء في المكونات). 3. النظافة والصيانة والاشتراطات الصحية: * التقديم بالزي الموحد الكامل، مع ارتداء القفازات وغطاء الرأس بشكل مستمر. * تنظيف وتطهير أسطح العمل، الجريل، القلايات، والأدوات قبل وبعد التشغيل اليومي. * التخلص من النفايات والمحافظة على البيئة الداخلية والخارجية للفود ترك نظيفة تماماً وفق معايير البلدية. * مراقبة درجات حرارة الثلاجات والمجمدات وتخزين المواد الغذائية بشكل صحي وآمن. 4. إدارة المخزون: * متابعة النقص في المواد الخام وإبلاغ المالك مسبقاً قبل نفادها. ### المؤهلات والمهارات المطلوبة الشغف في العمل * الشهادة الصحية: شهادة صحية سارية من منصة بلدي (أو الجاهزية لإصدارها فوراً). * مهارات التواصل: قدرة ممتازة على التعامل مع العملاء وخدمتهم بلباقة وسرعة. * المهارات الفنية: إجادة التعامل مع أنظمة البيع الإلكترونية (POS) وأجهزة الدفع الشبكي. * السرعة والقدرة على تحمل الضغط: مهارة العمل السريع وتعدد المهام (Multitasking) في مساحة محدودة وخلال أوقات الذروة.

12a2bdbbcdbf539c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مصنع باب الفهد للصناعة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات واستراتيجيات المبيعات، وتقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة لدعم الأهداف البيعية للمؤسسة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم واحتياجاتهم. متابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية المحتملة. تقييم نتائج أعمال مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ التقارير والوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق المؤسسة في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية وتطوير استراتيجيات السوق. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في مؤسسة مصنع باب الفهد للصناعة.

12be28f7e1e95778.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب اليمامه للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على دعم المهندسين الكهربائيين في تنفيذ المشاريع. المهام الرئيسية يتولى فني الهندسة الكهربائية مسؤولية الإشراف على تركيب المكونات الكهربائية واختبارها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم الفني. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في حل المشكلات الفنية التي قد تطرأ. المسؤوليات التفصيلية يُتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة أداء مجموعة من المسؤوليات التي تضمن سير العمل بكفاءة ودقة، وتشمل: تحديد المخطط وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية للمشاريع. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين فيما يتعلق بأعمال تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية. اختبار النظم بعد تركيبها لضمان التقيد بالمخطط الأولي والمواصفات المطلوبة للمشروع. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك أساساً قوياً في الهندسة الكهربائية مع خبرة عملية محدودة. المتطلبات الأساسية هي: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الهندسة الكهربائية ضمن فريق في مكتب اليمامه للاستشارات الهندسية بالرياض. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع لدعم المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

12666b08d2daf717.description: OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. 12a7fd9af7febbe1.description: Job Description WSP is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor (MEP) to join our team on a major infrastructure construction supervision project in Madinah. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing all MEP quantity surveying activities, including measurement, valuation, cost control, payment certification, and variation assessment across a complex infrastructure environment. Working closely with the Resident Engineer, Construction Supervision Team, Contractors, and Client representatives, the Quantity Surveyor (MEP) will play a key role in ensuring accurate commercial administration and contract compliance throughout the project lifecycle. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Review and verify MEP-related quantities based on approved drawings and project specifications. Perform quantity take-offs, measurements, remeasurements, and quantity verification for infrastructure works. Evaluate and assess variations, change orders, claims, and additional works in accordance with contract requirements. Review contractors' interim payment applications and provide recommendations for certification. Monitor project costs and ensure compliance with approved budgets and contractual provisions. Verify completed work on site and coordinate with engineering and supervision teams regarding progress and measurements. Review Bills of Quantities (BOQ), specifications, preambles, and contract documents to ensure accurate valuation of works. Prepare cost estimates and quantity reports as required by the project. Maintain records of measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and cost reports. Assist in the preparation of commercial correspondence and contractual documentation. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to resolve commercial and technical issues related to MEP works. Ensure all quantity surveying activities comply with project procedures, contract conditions, and industry best practices. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Quantity Surveying, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 7–10 years of Quantity Surveying experience in tunnel and infrastructure projects, preferably on major infrastructure projects. Strong multidisciplinary MEP knowledge covering: HVAC Systems Fire Fighting Systems Electrical Systems (HV/MV/LV) ELV Systems Telecommunications SCADA Systems Wet Utilities including Potable Water, Sewerage, Stormwater, and Irrigation Networks. Proven experience in quantity take-off, quantity verification, remeasurement, and assessment of scope changes based on approved drawings. Extensive experience in reviewing and certifying interim payment applications and assessing variations under both Lump Sum and Re-measurable contracts. Sound understanding of BOQ descriptions, Contract Preambles, and CESMM4 measurement principles. Practical hands-on experience in MEP Quantity Surveying and post-contract commercial management activities is essential. Demonstrated ability to evaluate contractor submissions, measurements, payment certificates, variation orders, and claims for infrastructure projects. Proficiency in AutoCAD and advanced Microsoft Excel is mandatory. Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Previous experience working on construction supervision, PMC, or infrastructure consultancy projects in the Middle East is highly desirable. Membership of a recognized professional body such as RICS or equivalent will be considered an advantage. Essential Requirement: Given the multidisciplinary nature of the project, candidates must possess strong practical experience in MEP quantity surveying, commercial administration, payment certification, variation assessment, and post-contract cost management within large-scale infrastructure and tunnel projects. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today.

12c1273f28d4c489.description: Design the Vision. Deliver the Detail. The most rewarding spaces are the ones you help bring to life, not just the ones you imagine. If you combine a designer’s creativity with the technical precision to see a project through on-site, this opportunity puts both strengths to work. Our client, a growing luxury interior design and construction company in Riyadh, is seeking an Interior Design Engineer to turn client ambitions into thoughtfully designed, carefully executed interiors. A compelling concept is only the beginning. The real achievement is preserving its character through every drawing, material selection, and finishing detail. In this role, you’ll connect creative direction with practical delivery. Working closely with clients, design teams, contractors, and suppliers, you’ll help ensure that finished spaces reflect the approved vision while meeting functional requirements and project timelines. For a hands-on designer, this is an opportunity to stay involved where your decisions matter: from the first client conversation to the final site inspection. About Our Client Our client specialises in luxury interior design and construction execution for corporate and private clients. Based in Riyadh, the company manages projects across the full lifecycle, bringing together concept development, design, project management, and on-site delivery.Its work requires more than visual appeal. Every project calls for an understanding of how a space should look, function, and be built. You’ll contribute to the full process, working where design intent meets materials, craftsmanship, and client expectations. What You’ll Own You’ll take an active role across the design and execution journey, with responsibilities that extend beyond the drawing board. Translate client ambitions into a clear design direction. Develop mood boards, color schemes, and material palettes that balance aesthetic preferences with the practical needs of each space. Create photorealistic visualizations using 3ds Max with V-Ray or Corona to help clients understand and confidently approve the concept. Turn approved concepts into buildable details. Produce accurate Revit and AutoCAD execution drawings, architectural layouts, joinery details, and finishing specifications that give execution teams clear guidance. Bring the right materials into the finished space. Source and evaluate materials, select and approve samples, coordinate with suppliers, negotiate terms, and manage delivery schedules to support project progress. Protect design quality on-site. Conduct regular visits during finishing stages, review work against approved drawings, and collaborate with contractors to resolve discrepancies and practical challenges. Keep clients informed and projects moving. Lead design presentations, explain recommendations clearly, communicate progress, and address design questions as they arise throughout execution. What Makes You Successful You’re a designer who cares as much about how a space is built as how it looks. You can move confidently between creative exploration, technical documentation, and on-site problem-solving without losing sight of the client’s priorities. You hold a bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or Architectural Engineering, supported by proven experience in both concept development and on-site finishing supervision. Your technical capabilities include strong proficiency in 3ds Max, Revit, AutoCAD, and Photoshop, alongside a sound understanding of materials, furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E), joinery, and interior construction details. Additional skills in SketchUp, Lumion, or V-Ray are an advantage. You understand the Saudi design, construction, events, and luxury projects market. Just as importantly, you communicate effectively, handle client requirements thoughtfully, and coordinate multiple projects under tight deadlines. Your portfolio should tell the complete project story: initial concepts, 3D renders, execution drawings, and photographs of completed spaces. What’s In It for You This opportunity brings together the creative and technical sides of interior design in one role. You’ll work on luxury interiors, engage directly with clients, and stay connected to the execution of your designs rather than handing them off at the visualisation stage. The breadth of the work offers practical opportunities to deepen your expertise in material selection, supplier coordination, construction detailing, and site supervision while contributing to a growing business in Riyadh. Bring Your Best Work to Life If you’re ready to take your designs from concept to completed space, we’d like to see what you can create and deliver. Apply with your CV and portfolio, showcasing the projects you’ve helped shape from the first idea to the final finish.

12985a603b39a444.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. You will work closely with internal cross-functional teams such as Customer Success, Operations, and Sales teams, and will be on top of opportunities generated from the existing customer base or creating your own opportunities to grow your customer portfolio, identifying wins that add value to the customer and Foodics. The ideal candidate will have solid skills in sales, account management, and product knowledge. And has a technical background to help navigate all sales and deliver the solutions that the customers need ensuring successful outcomes and growth. What Will You Do❓ Responsible for selling of the Foodics Pay products to our clients. Building a pipeline with opportunities that is always active with a strong closing rate. Maintaining solid relationships with customers and delivering great outcomes with a high value to the customer, ensuring growth and revenue generation. Closing “pre-generated” opportunities from cross-functional teams and consulting with the customer on potential cross-sell and up-sell opportunities. Understand the market landscape and align with customers on market trends and direction and how to maintain a competitive advantage at all times. Engaging with customers, demonstrating and showcasing our products. Holding Demos with potential customers and ensuring utilization. Reporting closed wins, and closed lost and enhancing the process to deliver better results. Calling customers, scheduling meetings, and remaining on top of customer’s needs. What Are We Looking For❓ Preferably Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or relevant studies. 2-3 years of work experience in a relevant field. Prior proven track record in sales, pipeline, and funnel management, managing an entire sales cycle and ensuring full-service delivery. High agility and able to cope in a fast-paced work environment. Building strong, trusting relationships with customers and internal stakeholders. Ownership, analytical mindset, self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit. Team player and previously worked with cross-functional teams. Must have solid English & Arabic communication skills. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Passion for Food and Restaurants. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-offices. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

1245bfd3c7d22f90.description: We are looking for an E-Commerce & Marketplace Operations Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of our e-commerce store and marketplaces, including Zid, Amazon, Trendyol, and other sales channels . The role will be responsible for the full order lifecycle — from receiving and processing orders to fulfillment, shipping, delivery, inventory coordination, and resolving operational issues. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, hands-on, and capable of coordinating effectively between the warehouse, branches, customer service, marketplaces, and logistics partners. Key Responsibilities E-Commerce & Order Fulfillment Manage and monitor daily orders through the Zid Dashboard . Review and process incoming orders and ensure they are ready for fulfillment. Manage the complete order lifecycle from order receipt to picking, packing, shipping, and delivery. Coordinate Picking, Packing & Order Fulfillment with the warehouse team. Monitor pending and delayed orders and take immediate action to resolve issues. Handle operational issues related to missing items, incorrect orders, cancellations, exchanges, and returns. Ensure orders are processed and shipped within the required turnaround time. Marketplace Operations Manage daily operations across Amazon, Trendyol, and other marketplaces . Process and monitor marketplace orders according to each platform’s requirements and SLA. Ensure order and shipment statuses are updated accurately. Monitor marketplace cancellations, returns, delayed orders, and fulfillment issues. Coordinate inventory availability across the website and marketplaces. Identify and resolve operational issues that may negatively impact marketplace performance. Coordinate issues related to SKUs, barcodes, product mapping, and inventory synchronization . Inventory & Branch Coordination Monitor inventory availability across the e-commerce store and marketplaces. Coordinate with the warehouse and branches to ensure stock availability. Manage and follow up on stock transfers and replenishment between the warehouse and branches . Monitor low-stock and out-of-stock items and escalate when replenishment is required. Identify and resolve discrepancies between physical and system inventory. Ensure accurate SKU and barcode mapping across all sales channels. Shipping & Logistics Operations Manage daily operational coordination with courier and logistics partners. Ensure orders are assigned to the appropriate shipping provider. Monitor AWB creation, shipment pickup, delivery, and shipment status . Follow up on delayed, failed, or returned shipments. Coordinate with couriers, warehouse, and customer service teams to resolve delivery issues. Monitor recurring shipping problems and escalate them when required. Operations Control & Reporting Ensure accurate and timely order status updates across all systems and marketplaces. Conduct daily follow-ups on pending, delayed, and exception orders. Coordinate between E-Commerce, Marketplaces, Warehouse, Branches, Customer Service, and Logistics . Prepare operational reports covering order fulfillment, delays, cancellations, returns, and operational errors. Identify recurring operational issues and implement corrective actions. Recommend process improvements and automation opportunities to increase efficiency and reduce manual work. Requirements 2–4 years of experience in E-Commerce Operations, Marketplace Operations, Order Fulfillment, or a similar role. Hands-on experience in order processing, inventory management, fulfillment, and logistics operations. Experience with Zid is highly preferred. Experience with Amazon Seller Central and other marketplaces is preferred. Good understanding of Order Fulfillment, Inventory Management, and Marketplace Operations . Familiarity with SKU management, barcodes, inventory synchronization, and stock transfers . Good knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets . Strong organizational, follow-up, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage a high volume of orders and coordinate across multiple teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to take ownership of daily operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-Time Fulfillment Rate Order Accuracy Marketplace SLA Compliance Pending & Delayed Orders Order Cancellation Rate Inventory Accuracy Stock Availability Return & Failed Delivery Rate Issue Resolution Time Overall Operational Efficiency
